# Feature: Teleport pair — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #3 (Teleport pair) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: enter one pad, exit its twin. Unique: only instant relocation between two fixed pads. Useful: links sealed chambers and makes one-way routing puzzles. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** enter one pad, exit its twin.

**So that** links sealed chambers and makes one-way routing puzzles.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Teleport pair for the first time in its teaching room (mech-3-teleport-pair-room). Teaching moment: First room: two pads of different marks in one chamber. A player who steps on pads at random arrives back where they started and makes no progress, which teaches that pads are pairs to be identified rather than doors that simply open. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on a pad instantly moves you to its paired pad (same mark) keeping your direction
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: If a block sits on the twin, the teleport does not happen
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pads work both ways

## Edge Cases & Rules

- If a block sits on the twin, the teleport does not happen
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Teleport pair's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-3-teleport-pair-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #3.
